result.instructions: Tools for ButterCMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my five newest blog posts and who wrote each one."; "Search my blog for posts about pricing and show the summaries."; "Show all items in my 'testimonials' collection.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ButterCMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run buttercms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run buttercms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run buttercms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. buttercms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: buttercms_list_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: List published blog posts, newest first, with optional filters by author, category or tag. Use exclude_body to get short results. Read API: GET /posts/.

exclude_body.description: true = leave out the full post body (smaller response).

author_slug.description: Only posts by this author slug.

category_slug.description: Only posts in this category slug.

tag_slug.description: Only posts with this tag slug.

locale.description: Locale API slug, for example 'en' or 'fr'. Default: the account default locale.

preview.description: true = return the latest draft version instead of the published one.

tools.title: Get a blog post
tools.description: Get one blog post by slug, with the full body, metadata, and the next and previous posts. Read API: GET /posts/{slug}/.

locale.description: Locale API slug, for example 'en' or 'fr'. Default: the account default locale.

locale.description: Locale API slug, for example 'en' or 'fr'. Default: the account default locale.

tools.name: buttercms_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List pages of one page type, or all Single Pages with page_type '*'. Filtering and ordering work only for a real page type. Read API: GET /pages/{page_type}/.

page_type.description: Page type slug, or '*' for Single Pages.

order.description: Order by 'published', 'updated' or a field of the page type. Prefix '-' for descending.

fields.description: Filter by field value, for example {"headline": "Hello"}. Keys are field names; nested fields use dots.

locale.description: Locale API slug, for example 'en' or 'fr'. Default: the account default locale.

levels.description: Depth of referenced content to include (1-5). Higher values give larger responses.

preview.description: true = return the latest draft version instead of the published one.

tools.name: buttercms_get_page
tools.title: Get a page
tools.description: Get one page by page type and slug. Use '*' as page_type for a Single Page. Read API: GET /pages/{page_type}/{page_slug}/.

page_type.description: Page type slug, or '*' to search all page types.

locale.description: Locale API slug, for example 'en' or 'fr'. Default: the account default locale.

levels.description: Depth of referenced content to include (1-5). Higher values give larger responses.

preview.description: true = return the latest draft version instead of the published one.

page_type.description: Only this page type slug, or '*' for Single Pages.

locale.description: Locale API slug, for example 'en' or 'fr'. Default: the account default locale.

levels.description: Depth of referenced content to include (1-5). Higher values give larger responses.
